comment: Public-domain USGS map PDFs for GPU and CPU render comparisons. Download on demand with scripts/FetchComparisonCorpus.cs; checksums and byte counts pin the exact files. Neither the PDFs nor the local aviation charts are redistributed by this repository.

documents.source: U.S. Geological Survey Historical Topographic Map Collection
documents.licence: Public domain: USGS topographic map published in 1957. USGS says all its topographic maps are public domain except three US Topo data cases from 2009 onward.

Public domain: 2023 US Topo map of West Virginia/Virginia. USGS lists commercial road data only for 2010-2016 US Topo maps and commercial orthoimagery for Alaska and pre-2017 Hawaii maps; this map falls outside those cases.
